logpath.description: The directory where the procmail logfile is stored.

verbose.description: Enable or disable extended diagnostics. Use 'yes' or 'no'.

maildir.description: The default directory for mail delivery.

default_folder.description: The default mailbox file name within MAILDIR.

bounce_on_error.description: Whether to bounce mail on delivery errors. Use 'yes' or 'no'.

safepath.description: If set, procmail restricts PATH to this value only. Leave empty for default PATH.

dropprivs.description: Drop privileges before executing filters. Use 'yes' or 'no'.
